title: Sen's hidden-variable model bears no relation to invariant set theory

statements.text: Hance, Hossenfelder and Palmer reply that Sen's model lets experimenters control aspects of the hidden variables, which has no counterpart in invariant set theory, and drops its number-theoretic constraints on counterfactuals. His conclusions therefore do not apply to it.

sources.quote: the hidden-variable model of quantum physics he uses to critique Invariant Set Theory bares no relation to Invariant Set Theory
